title: Mathematics schema bundle descriptor
description: Prebuilt CUSTOM schema bundle. Declares the Mathematics ontology: element/relationship types, endpoint legality (schema-bundle.rules.json), the actor element type used by the ARGO wakeup gate, and the graph invariants. Models mathematical knowledge (domains/concepts/definitions/axioms/theorems/conjectures/proofs/counterexamples/techniques), problem solving (problems/solution steps/skills) and the formal/computational layer (formal libraries/benchmarks).
